mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_identities ( user_id, provider, provider_user_id, provider_email ) VALUES ( #{userId}, 'LOCAL', #{providerUserId}, #{providerEmail} )
INSERT INTO auth_identities ( user_id, provider, provider_user_id, provider_email ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{providerEmail} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, nickname, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}
SELECT id, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, nickname, status FROM users WHERE email = #{email}

SELECT u.id, u.email, u.password_hash AS passwordHash, u.nickname, u.status FROM auth_identities ai JOIN users u ON u.id = ai.user_id WHERE ai.provider = #{provider} AND ai.provider_user_id = #{providerUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_sessions ( user_id, refresh_token_hash, device_name, ip_address, user_agent, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{refreshTokenHash}, #{deviceName}, CAST(#{ipAddress} AS INET), #{userAgent}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId}
